metadata.description: Claude Code skills — LLM council deliberation, wargaming, and McKinsey-style deck content.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Convene an LLM Council — five independent persona advisors deliberate in parallel, blind-review each other, and a chairman delivers a verdict with concrete next steps.

plugins.name: wargame
plugins.description: Wargame a subsystem's failure surfaces move-by-move (forks, counter-moves, abort conditions, red-team) so a cheaper model can execute or harden it blind.

plugins.name: mckinsey-deck
plugins.description: Create slide-deck content in Markdown applying McKinsey criteria — Pyramid Principle, action titles, MECE, quantified so-whats with sources.

plugins.name: deck-design-prompt
plugins.description: Turn a finished deck.md into a ready-to-paste Claude Design prompt that applies visual design without touching content.
